- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended eco-friendly reusable water bottles: S'well, Klean Kanteen, Hydro Flask, Nalgene, and Larq.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] S'well bottles are made from stainless steel, non-toxic, BPA-free, and come in various designs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Klean Kanteen offers a range of reusable bottles made from stainless steel, silicone, and BPA-free plastic.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hydro Flask bottles are known for their insulation properties and are made from BPA-free stainless steel.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nalgene bottles are made from BPA-free Tritan material, shatter-resistant, and dishwasher safe.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Larq bottles are self-cleaning and use UV light to eliminate bacteria and viruses.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested checking official websites for promotions or discounts on Hydro Flask and S'well.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hydro Flask has a "Deal of the Week" section and offers a 10% discount for first-time customers who sign up for their email newsletter.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] S'well has a "Sale" section and offers a 15% discount for first-time customers who sign up for their email newsletter.
- [USER] User is looking for a bottle that can keep drinks hot for at least 6 hours.

- [USER] User is considering a 32 oz bottle with a matte finish.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Both Hydro Flask and S'well offer matte finish options for their bottles.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hydro Flask's matte finish is a powder-coated finish available in several colors, including Graphite, Black, and White.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] S'well's matte finish is a soft, textured finish available in several colors, including Onyx, White, and Sand.
